source.classification: frozen UI-frame vector (regression) plus independent frame-free elongation oracle
source.note: Planet-minus-Sun elongations come from Mangal and are the independent mathematical gate; they are unchanged. The absolute UI-frame vector is a regression freeze of this page's Modern Bhāratīya (dṛk) tier, not an independent value: re-derived 2026-10-08 as math-core canonicalGrahaModel(2460676.5, { mode: 'drik' }) rounded to 1e-6° (sidereal, true Citrā-pakṣa 24.206398° applied), when the retired 'calibrated' mode was replaced by the three tiers. Against Mangal's elongations this tier differs by at most 0.0019° (Saturn) at this instant. Nodes are tested for frozen placement and exact antipodality because the engines use different pāta conventions (the dṛk tier's Rāhu is the series' mean node).

retired.note: The vector frozen for the retired 'calibrated' mode (VSOP87/ELP Sun-frame hybrid), kept for the record only; no test reads it.
